Done. I've implemented all three functions:

1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js — limits n to the inclusive range [min, max] using early returns
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js — converts byte counts to B/KB/MB/GB with one decimal place for the larger units
3. **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js — transforms strings to slugs: lowercase, trim, spaces→dashes, strips invalid characters, collapses consecutive dashes

All follow the project's style conventions and are exported.
